newsitem.title: GREECE: MAIN GREEK 98 ECON GOAL IS TO CUT INFLATION BELOW 3.0PCT-MIN.
newsitem.headline: MAIN GREEK 98 ECON GOAL IS TO CUT INFLATION BELOW 3.0PCT-MIN.

text.p: The main goal of Greece's economic policy is to reduce inflation below 3.0 percent in 1998, National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou told reporters.
"It constitutes a central goal of economic policy to bring down inflation below 3.0 percent in 1998," said Papandoniou.
CPI-based inflation edged up to 5.5 percent year-on-year in June from 5.4 percent in May. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
